matched_packages.name: hnlyxiaobing/MBOpenClacky/lib/config
matched_packages.summary:
Provides agent and model configuration for the MBOpenClacky package. It loads and saves AgentConfig from TOML files and environment variables, manages model lists and switching, resolves built-in ProviderPreset providers by base URL, and exposes model capabilities, API type resolution, fallback and lite model mappings, and permission modes.

matched_packages.name: bobzhang/bap/plugins/dependencies
matched_packages.summary:
Provides the dependencies plugin for BAP, collecting and rendering the dependency information of binary units. It loads units and their library dependency closures, searches for unit files via ldconfig-like caches or library paths, and renders results in YAML, S-expression, JSON, or graph formats.

Keywords: bap, dependencies, DependencyInfo, DependencyState, DependencyFormat, DependencyCache, LdconfigCache, declare_plugin, load_unit, of_image, search, yaml, sexp, json, graph
